content: FastAPI UploadFile wraps tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile (default max_size 1MB in Starlette MultiPartParser): stays in memory then rolls to disk; rollover also forced by fileno()/rollover(); seek(0) required before a second read; bytes=File() loads whole body into RAM (OOM risk). max_size is a rollover policy, NOT an input size cap - enforce app-level limits. This directly conflicts with project no-temp-files constraint; streaming to R2 must avoid spooled disk spill and must rewind before handoff.
